source_scope.reason: Exact source-content isolation onto the selected baseline, retaining original build/hardware provenance; no policy change or omitted artifact behavior.

This accepts this controlled activation interval only, not a cure or universal prevention for the older boot/shutdown incident; that fault and recovery checks remain.

The release changes only non-Paging/non-ContextSwitch NullRendering software entry ownership/admission. Existing non-NullRendering real command capture, render/copy, Present UMD and ordinary window paths retain their production bytes/branches; non-GDI window-Present already selected the reserved entry. The changed software fence and ordinary KMT control passed with the same available DWM and no new restart. Legacy first-Present replay remains excluded and the historical fault remains open; no claim that its scenario is fixed.

The optional process-scoped WDDM2.0 offer/Present1 fix, UMD/NVK and all swap-chain code are absent from this independent release-source delta and runtime component change. Their previously excluded scenarios stay excluded. Ordinary admission is a separate control in that same program. Promotion of these bounded semantics is distinct from formal fault closure; the fault stays open, old MAX/DDI gaps persist, and no three-run or broader NullRendering qualification is claimed.

decision: Eligible for existing repository independent qualification checks, with all faults retained; actual selection/activation still requires successful checks.
important_interpretation: The target fault is covered by its changed-input positive witness; it is not falsely called disjoint. Historical first-Present overlap remains unknown and excluded. The independent qualification records bounded release evidence without equating it with closure.
